name: Procore and Autodesk data exchange
summary: What moves between Track3D and Procore or Autodesk Construction Cloud once a project is linked: RFIs, observations, submittals, issues, photos and designs, plus the inbound notifications that keep imported designs current.

roles.note: The Procore and Autodesk pass-through routes need only a signed-in user and use that user's own connection. The seed catalog has import-design and export-note in its Integration group, but no route read here was seen checking export-note.

actions.action: Import a design from Procore or Autodesk
Send a note to Procore or Autodesk as an RFI, observation or issue
Browse Procore or Autodesk data through Track3D
actions.note: Access details for this item are handled with engineering separately.

nfr.statement: Delay between a new design version in Procore or Autodesk and the updated design in Track3D.
nfr.open_question: How soon must a new Procore or Autodesk design version appear in Track3D (PRD open question on sync frequency)?

requirements.title: RFIs, observations and submittals show in both Track3D and Procore
requirements.statement: In a project linked to Procore, users can create and edit RFIs, observations and submittals in Track3D, and each item is linked to Procore and visible in both. If the project isn't linked, the user is asked to link it first.

sources.title: Prior PRD - Integration (merged Procore and SMS assistant) (t3d-prd-agent prd-organised)

open_checks: Which fields sync and how permission differences between the two platforms are handled are open PRD questions

acceptance_criteria.when: A user creates an RFI in Track3D
acceptance_criteria.then: The RFI is visible in both Track3D and Procore

acceptance_criteria.given: A project not linked to Procore
acceptance_criteria.when: A user tries to create a Procore RFI
acceptance_criteria.then: They are asked to link the project to Procore first

requirements.title: Observations flow both ways and photos sync to Procore
requirements.statement: Task observations can be sent from Track3D to Procore and received back. Photos sync from Track3D to Procore without loss or duplicates; on a network failure the sync retries or tells the user. Differences in observation data between the platforms are shown for the user to resolve.
open_checks: No photo sync to Procore was found in the code read for this migration

acceptance_criteria.when: The user syncs them to Procore
acceptance_criteria.then: Every photo arrives once, with none lost or duplicated

requirements.title: Track3D inside Procore, and Procore models and drawings in Track3D
requirements.statement: Track3D can be opened and fully used inside the Procore interface, and can pull models and drawings from Procore.
open_checks: The gateway sends X-Frame-Options DENY and frame-ancestors 'none' on API responses (proxy.authz.ts#L39@26221f6c7bb3); check how embedding in Procore works today

acceptance_criteria.then: Track3D works fully inside the Procore interface

requirements.title: Link Track3D notes to Autodesk issues and RFIs
requirements.statement: Users can link a Track3D note to an Autodesk Construction Cloud issue or RFI, carrying ID, title, description, status, start and due dates, assignee, watchers, location, type and attachments. Incomplete data is handled without failing.

sources.title: Prior PRD - Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) integration (t3d-prd-agent prd-organised)
Direct code reads during USER migration (2026-10-29)

open_checks: Whether attachments are supported and what happens when the ACC issue is deleted after linking are open in the PRD. The code has create, update and create-with-attachments issue routes

acceptance_criteria.given: A note in a project linked to Autodesk
acceptance_criteria.when: The user links it to an ACC issue
acceptance_criteria.then: The issue carries the note's title, description, status, dates, assignee, watchers, location and type

requirements.title: Designs imported from Procore or Autodesk follow new versions automatically
requirements.statement: When Procore reports a changed drawing or file, or Autodesk reports a new version, Track3D imports the new version as the next revision of each active design imported from that source. A design already at that revision is skipped.
